# dr_libs vendored licenses

This directory vendors single-header decoders from
[dr_libs](https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs) by David Reid (mackron@gmail.com).

Each file is dual-licensed under your choice of:

- **Unlicense** (public domain dedication)
- **MIT No Attribution**

Both options are compatible with PCMFlow's MIT license. Full license text
is at the bottom of each `dr_*.h` file. No attribution is technically
required, but we note authorship here for clarity.

Vendored files:

- `dr_mp3.h` — MP3 decoder
